name: Chicken-Foot Hut
description: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.

abilities.name: Fast
abilities.description: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.

abilities.name: Double Strike
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

abilities.name: Pin
abilities.description: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target. The Hut drags the Restrained target when it moves.
